backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no methods defined.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files and components with high-confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing major frontend files, their roles, and thematic styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color variables and dark‑mode variants with global border and background rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and setting the page title to myvalentinepiku.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component showing ValentineProposal and footer with app name and copy‑to‑clipboard share link.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Valent: Interactive Valentine prompt with moving 'No' button and success screen showing a heart animation and meme image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and refreshing a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity login, logout, stored identities, and state transitions.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind styles with romantic pink‑themed light/dark color tokens, heart animations, and gradient text effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry script setting up React Query and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, requirements, features, and notes for the Valentine proposal web app, including domain and asset update needs.
